# Where this comes from

We are building an ecosystem of composable Julia packages for infectious
disease modelling.

## Chains of models lose the uncertainty

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="30%"}
**A chain of models**

::: {.cascade}
```{mermaid}
flowchart TB
  P["Prevalence"] --> I["Incidence"]
  I --> R["R(t)"]
  R --> S["Variant severity"]
```
:::

- Every arrow is a handover. Uncertainty is approximated at each one and
  the answers can be biased
- The ONS infection survey ran this way
:::
::: {.column width="70%"}
**One model**

![](../figures/fig-bvd-model.png){width="94%"
fig-alt="Directed graph of the DRC Bundibugyo outbreak model. One
reproduction number drives infections, infections feed onsets through an
incubation period, and onsets feed suspected cases, exports, deaths and
isolation occupancy, all inside a single joint model."}

- Fitting everything together avoids the handovers. It is slower to
  build, because each model gets written from scratch

::: {.attribution}
Left panel is a schematic of the cascade, drawn for this talk. Cascade
and joint modelling argument from the composable modelling paper,
Abbott et al., in preparation, after Lison et al. 2024 · right panel is
the 2026 DRC Bundibugyo outbreak model,
[BVDOutbreakSize](https://github.com/epiforecasts/BVDOutbreakSize),
one renewal process and many observation streams.
:::
:::
::::

## Six years of packages that do not come apart

:::: {.columns}
::: {.column width="52%"}
::: {.nowrap}
| Package | Since | Reused as |
|---|---|---|
| `EpiNow2` | 2020 | All of it |
| `epinowcast` | 2021 | All of it |
| `epidist` | 2023 | All of it |
| `primarycensored` | 2024 | Copied source |
| `CensoredDistributions.jl` | 2024 | A distribution |
:::

::: {.attribution}
Repository creation dates from the GitHub API, 2026-08-10 ·
the copy is `inst/stan/functions/LICENSE.primarycensored` in
`epinowcast`, licence file and all, and both packages are mine.
:::
:::
::: {.column width="48%"}
- I started `epinowcast` in 2021 to be the modular one. Every component
  could be switched out. It still cannot be taken apart into pieces
  anyone else can use
- The same structural request has been written down in `EpiNow2` four
  times since 2020. Two closed as done and left the package no easier
  to take apart. Two are still open
- At least seven packages fit renewal models in Stan and share no
  component. `EpiSewer` and `wwinference` share none either
- We wrote down a workflow for building these models, then could not
  follow it with the tools we had built. The paper gives a schematic
  case study rather than code

::: {.attribution}
